title: The United States declares war on Japan
summary: The US Congress declared war on Japan on 8 December 1941 after the attack on Pearl Harbor. President Franklin Roosevelt addressed Congress before the vote.

claims.text: The US Congress declared war on Japan on 8 December 1941 after the attack on Pearl Harbor. President Franklin Roosevelt addressed Congress before the vote.
